The configuration uses common practices such as prefix filtering (`v`) and exclusion of pre-release versions.

This file poses no security risk. It is a declarative configuration with no side effects and contains no obfuscated or malicious logic. It does not deviate from expected AUR maintainer workflows for version tracking.
